title: Associate provider launcher RUN locators from split streamed output
outcome: A valid launcher RUN locator split across Codex output deltas associates with its exact original provider observation, including when no measured check exists.
acceptance: Exercise a split locator through the native router with a real original observation and exact launcher artifact.
Duplicate/conflicting starts, mismatched or ambiguous provenance, and overflow do not attach a locator or grant credit.
